The North American Challengers League – North America’sLeague of LegendsTier 2 system – is in its home stretch.

Six teams remain in the NACL Summer Playoffs, but the prize isn’t merely a trophy. The top two teams qualify for the League Championship Series’ promotion-relegation tournament, set to happen later this year.

The finalists in the NACL Playoffs will join a pair of Liga Regional Norte teams and current LCS guest spot holder Disguised in a five-team event to qualify for North America’s Tier 1 system.

The lure of playing on stage in the LCS is enough to excite Cupid Esports coach Samuel “boc” Boudrie and his players.

title: Fnatic breaks international streaks in League of Legends, VALORANT
summary: Fnatic breaks international streaks in League of Legends, VALORANT  Esports.gg
content:
XC is a long-time player and enjoyer of anything video games, with some tech on the side. He has spent countless hours on MOBAs, single-player RPGs, and competitive shooters. XC's also a massive esports fan.

Perhaps enough fans spammed this static to help Fnatic.

Fnatic has been a consistent presence in the apex international events for both League of Legends and VALORANT. It was always an organization that European esports fans could rally behind. In 2026, though, a series of unfortunate match results caused Fnatic to break their streak of being at Worlds and Champions.

Fnatic was there when LoL Esports began. The org even picked up the win at the inaugural World Championship back in 2011. Since then, they’ve made it to almost every Worlds, missing only two iterations in 2012 and 2016.

The League of Legends Fnatic team didn’t have the best performance in the LEC 2026 Summer. The 10-team league needed them to place at sixth or higher to qualify for playoffs, but they just barely missed it. They ended the season at3W-6L, finishing the regular season atseventh place.

Granted, there was a glimmer of hope there after they took the series against their long-time rivals,G2 Esports. Their other two wins, however, were against bottom teamsShiftersandSK Gaming, and they dropped the series against all the other teams. Their do-or-die match against GIANTX sealed their fate —Fnatic would missWorlds, ending their nine-year streak of consecutive appearances.
